# truenas_truecommand_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS TrueCommand service configuration and connection status. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one TrueCommand configuration per TrueNAS system. Makes no changes — see the truenas_truecommand_config resource's schema description for the safety notes around the "enabled" field and "api_key"'s Sensitive-but-not-write-only treatment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "truenas_truecommand_config" "config" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) 16-character API key generated by iX Portal, used to authenticate with TrueCommand services. Null when not configured.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this system is enabled to connect to a TrueCommand instance.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "truecommand_config".
- `remote_ip_address` (String) IP address of the connected TrueCommand instance. Null if not connected.
- `remote_url` (String) URL of the connected TrueCommand instance. Null if not connected.
- `status` (String) Current connection status with the TrueCommand service (e.g. CONNECTED, CONNECTING, DISABLED, FAILED).
- `status_reason` (String) Human-readable explanation of the current TrueCommand connection status.
